notes:
Customer snapshot: mid-stage developer-tools startup building an IDE-integrated coding assistant that surfaces repo-aware context (file-level and cross-repo). Primary ask: deterministic retrieval for code completions + low-latency streaming to the IDE (sub-80ms token latency target in EU), plus ability to pin model versions per workspace.

Summary of needs / constraints:
- Retrieval: embeddings-based vector DB indexed by repository, branch and commit hash. Need chunking logic that preserves code context (symbols, function boundaries) and maps tokens->chunks reproducibly.
- Vector DB ops: prefer Redwood-managed dedicated vector DB in EU region OR clear handoff docs if Syntax Weaver runs their own. Ops SLAs required.
- Latency: IDE streaming must natively support partial token streaming and cancellation from client; targeting 40-80ms tail for interactive completions at 512-context.
- Model/version pinning: customers want ability to pin model family + exact version to a workspace and force fallback to older quantized variant on mismatch.
- Security/residency: EU data residency is a hard requirement for the pilot. SSO (SAML) + audit logs + KMS integration required for production.
- Cost sensitivity: embedding storage and per-query vector cost key driver; exploring caching of prefix KV embeddings and dedupe at commit-level.
